scripts.title: Ultimate | Free Open-Source | Update 1
scripts.features:
Free Auto Farm, Macro & Progression (Open Source)

Features

- Auto Join Map with mode, world, difficulty, and act selection
- In-game macro recording, optimization, saving, and playback
- Auto Story, Quest, Challenge, and Rift automation
- Auto Summon, Shop, Craft, and Team loading
- Auto Claim rewards and redeem active codes
- Auto Stat Roll with customizable filters
- Discord webhook notifications
- Config and macro sharing
- English and Vietnamese interface
- Anti-AFK, performance optimization, and mobile support
- Auto reconnect and leave failsafes
- Persistent settings and timers
- No inventory or account data sent externally
- Completely free and open source
- No key system or paywall

If you find the script useful, please leave the project a star:

https://github.com/Truyem/Anime-Origins
